description: This file defines an abstract class 'HttpSpecializedException' that extends 'HttpException' within the Slim Framework. The class provides a constructor to initialize exception instances with an HTTP request, optional message, and a previous throwable.

classes.name: HttpSpecializedException
classes.description: An abstract exception class within the Slim framework designed to handle specialized HTTP exceptions, requiring an HTTP request object and optionally a message and previous exception.

methods.description: Constructor method initializing the exception with an HTTP request, optional message, and prior exception.
